positions.name: BareErasureDirective
positions.frame: How does a speaker perform knowledge erasure as a protocol step — commanding discard or removal through bare imperative, without rationale, consultation, or appeal?
positions.why: Both segments are imperative directives issued in the same flat formal register commanding erasure of specific knowledge (the Quixotic Zeppelin fleet and its helium contracts; all zeppelin routes). The register, power, relational, and conviction dimensions all read these two expressions identically: a protocol-distance imperative enacting authority-ranking through coercive insistence with no justification offered. The shared stance — bare command to forget or remove — genuinely spans both expressions.
